en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a river steamer crowded with passengers in the foreground and a large Gothic hilltop complex with tall spires and steep roofs rising above a town in the background. The boat is moving along a broad river; on the opposite bank are small houses and riverside buildings at the foot of a wooded hill crowned by the imposing cathedral-like structure and castle-like wings.
